correctness.rationale: The piecewise support law is exact for the convex hull of two filled coaxial disks. Uniform absolute axial cosine reduces probability to interval lengths. One quadratic inverse branch is extraneous below H, handled explicitly. Exact stationary-point calculus proves the three ordered heights, all max/min equality cases, and the two-regime diameter-exceedance tail. Taylor expansion gives a strict square-root onset. Independent finite support/CDF/mean checks were replayed successfully; they support but do not replace the all-parameter analytical derivation.

value.rationale: A complete probability law of directional width is a natural stereological invariant. The rigorous separation between local bifurcation, global maximum transition and global minimum transition is a nontrivial full classification for unequal-radius circular frusta, and the square-root onset supplies a sharp measurable transition. The cone and cylinder singular limits collapse pairs of these thresholds, underscoring that the positive-two-radius case is not a routine renamed endpoint result.
